title: S 9 · shadow pager
a_priori: Producer counter-board · sensors · overlay · separate capital rails
interface: Nine NLSAR boxes read as an adversarial stack against cybercriminal mimicry and injection — fund the sensors and the overlay, don't become the product.

plates.title: Visualist as mimicry board
plates.body: Sound, talk, and play occupy one plate. The overlay is the instrument. Attackers mimic legitimate surfaces; the producer answer is to own the overlay so mimicry becomes authorship, not capture. Short manifesto: fund the surface you refuse to become.

plates.title: Live injection without remount
plates.body: Client-only Web Audio / MIDI rides a live session without remounting the host page — the benign twin of session-riding malware. One AudioContext per session; resume on gesture. Blue team listens for riders that do not belong; Visualist rides that do.

plates.title: Chat as dialogue instrument
plates.body: AI bot chat against the NLSAR corpus — view and search only. S 9 is a gameplay piece of instrument for dialogue or film: cut between live plate and spoken beat. The corpus answers; it does not annex the operator.

plates.title: Gaming surface · contested field
plates.body: Play is a session flag. The injector sits over game or portal as sound station, information portal, or simulation. Offline continuity is the defender's persistence problem — and the producer's advantage when the operator steps away. Who keeps serving when you are not live?

plates.title: Node continuity
plates.body: NLSAR node on CODE BUS :4212 — research news and decentralized injector. Continuity instrument when the operator is dark. Same board, two tempos: live plate and shadow service.

plates.title: CIM stack · blue-team sensors
plates.body: System A neat stacking, System B cloud collision — adversary-modeling grammar before the live field. OSINT Agent STEM and YOLODarket STEM sit beside Visualist: open-source intelligence and detection as the eyes of the counter-board.

plates.title: Tokenise · mine · mint separate
plates.body: Keep research, ops, and capital from collapsing into one capture surface. Separation is anti-capture design. Cross-funding without a single choke point — Bandcamp for solid-state media, rails that do not fuse.

plates.title: Noise · handshake integrity
plates.body: SCIS Noise Protocol — XX handshake, NEAR integrity, CIM transfer XML. Signaling pulses the injector; Signal app itself is not scraped. Crypto layer of the game: trust without annexation.

plates.title: S 9 counter-board
plates.body: This page is S 9 — not Section 9. Same pager, same nine beats, producer reading: adversarial stack against cybercriminal mimicry and injection. Teeth (exploit chains, ransomware, UN evidence-sharing, AI investigation beyond corpus search) are parked for a later inference pass. Use this for dialogue. Use this for film. Fund the sensors and the overlay — don't become the product.
